_meta.description: Stage 1 (Registered) for the Connected Planning Pre-Sales Foundations journey — universal pre-sales-track foundational journey required before any per-application Pre-Sales journey.
_meta._audience_note: Required for Pre-Sales persona. Anchors the one-day instructor-led Pre-Sales Workshop and the universal pre-sales methodology that per-app Pre-Sales journeys assume.

_note: Stage 1 task structure for the Connected Planning Pre-Sales Foundations journey.
name: Registered
description: Pre-sales-track resource confirms journey understanding, partner portal access, pre-sales-resource profile, hybrid support engagement model, and Anaplan Overview + Anaplan Platform prereq completion.

tasks.title: Review Connected Planning Pre-Sales Foundations roadmap & expectations
tasks.description: Walk through the 3 stages of the Pre-Sales Foundations journey, what's covered in each (centerpiece is the one-day instructor-led Pre-Sales Workshop in Stage 2), and how this foundational journey routes to per-application Pre-Sales journeys (IFP Pre-Sales, etc.) on completion.

tasks.title: Complete pre-sales-resource profile
tasks.description: Augment the resource profile with pre-sales-specialization fields: prior pre-sales experience (years), prior products supported / demoed, technical specializations (modules, integrations, AI), demo languages, industries supported, region/territory. Manager attestation required to exit Stage 2.

tasks.title: Understand how to engage Anaplan pre-sales and partner support
tasks.description: Review the hybrid engagement model for pre-sales support — Anaplan PSE coordination for technical objections and competitive escalations, Partner Success for technical / platform questions, demo-platform support for environment issues, battlecard-and-content support, and how to use the Pre-Sales agent.

gates.description: Connected Planning Pre-Sales Foundations roadmap reviewed and acknowledged
Pre-sales and partner support engagement model acknowledged

_stage_exit_actions_note: No system-side actions on Stage 1 exit.
_estimated_effort_total_note: Two prereq verifications (Overview + Platform) — slightly heavier than Sales Foundations Stage 1 in process count but same effort range.
